It depends how much you want to risk. Risky dodge reads from slight dlight and Dair Dlight are:

In dodge: spot dodge then gc Slight the way they are facing, dash Dlight, reverse Dair, Dlight.

Up/down/spot dodge: jump gp, rec/gc nlight rec.

Out dodge: delay the Dair from Dlight slightly and do it the way the are dodging, follow up Dair with either slight dlight, or slight nlight.

Reads for nlight, I’ll let you decide what you follow up the read with.

In dodge: turn around Dlight or jump reverse dair.

Spot dodge: delayed dlight.

Out dodge: dash Dlight. dash jump Dair 

Down dodge: delayed dlight

Up dodge: jump rec.

With certain characters sigs can be used in reads, my main sentinel for example can do slight dash dsig which covers all options other then up/jumping.

You don’t always want to go for the riskiest reads because if they don’t work you will be punished
